newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SWIMMING-EUROPEAN RECORDS FOR RUSSIA AND SWEDEN.
newsitem.headline: SWIMMING-EUROPEAN RECORDS FOR RUSSIA AND SWEDEN.

text.p: Russia and Sweden claimed European relay records at the world short-course swimming championships on Thursday.

Russians Vladimir Selkov, Stanislav Lopchov, Denis Pankratov and Roman Egorov clocked three minutes 32.56 seconds in the men's 4x100 metres medley relay to beat the 3:35.36 set by Selkov, Dmitry Volkov, Pankratov and Evgeny Sadovyi in Gelsenkirchen, Germany, on February 12, 1993.

Sweden's Johanna Sjoberg, Josefin Lillhage, Louise Johncke and Malin Nilsson clocked 7:56.04 in the women's 4x200 freestyle relay to improve on the standard time of 8:00.08 set before official records were recognised in the event.
